_doc: Documented statuses no Bruno request can assert on its own response, with the reason. Read by build.py and api/bruno_coverage_test.go. Add an entry only when the status cannot be caused from outside a healthy stack.

getMe.429: Asserted in S6.12 on the burst's own 429 sample (pre-request calls), not on S6.12's own response, which is tenant B's 200.
getMe.500: Needs an internal failure (a dependency error mid-request); not caused from outside a healthy stack. Unit tests cover the mapping (internal/platform/apihttp).
getMe.501: getMe is implemented; 501 is the generated default for an unimplemented operation.

onboardTenant.429: Spec drift: operator routes are not rate limited (internal/server/api.go: the limiter wraps tenant routes only), so nava-onboard never answers 429.
onboardTenant.500: Needs a Keycloak or database failure mid-onboarding; not caused from outside a healthy stack.
